headword: {異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}

definitions.explanation: Weather conditions that deviate significantly from historical norms, such as record heatwaves, unusually heavy rainfall, or unprecedented cold spells.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There has been a lot of extreme weather this year.

examples.japanese: {異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{温暖|おんだん}{化|か}→温暖化：04622_ondanka⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that global warming is the cause of extreme weather.

examples.japanese: {異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{農作物|のうさくぶつ}→農作物：15271_nousakubutsu⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧になっている。
examples.english: Damage to crops from extreme weather is becoming serious.

notes:
USAGE:
A frequently used term in news broadcasts and newspaper articles. Japan experiences various forms of extreme weather including ⟦{猛暑|もうしょ}→猛暑：08311_mousho⟧ (intense heat), ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧ (heavy rain), and ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧ (heavy snow).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (extreme weather continues)
- {異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧ (damage from extreme weather)
- {異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧ (cause of abnormal weather)
- {異常|いじょう}{気象|きしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧ (extreme weather is increasing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天災|てんさい}→天災：29302_tensai⟧: natural disaster — a broader term including earthquakes and tsunamis
- ⟦{気候|きこう}{変動|へんどう}→気候変動：04627_kikouhendou⟧: climate change — refers to long-term trends, not individual events
